text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity as I stand at the threshold of this modern, brightly lit space. The angled perspective makes me slightly disoriented, like I’m entering a realm where established ideas might be challenged. The second image, with its focus on "R+D" (research and development), spurs philosophical musings on progress and the human desire to understand, enhance, and coexist with intelligent systems. I feel inspired by both the ingenuity on display and the questions this space evokes about our evolving relationship with technology and innovation.
